original_source: William Lilly 1647 Christian Astrology Wellcome b30338724
title: Whether the Disease the Native is subject unto be curable or not
scope: Historical 17th-century curability and disease-treatment predictions unvalidated as medical evidence.

groups.source_group: Original curability heading and favorable movable sign conjunction

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP CXXIX Whether Disease ... curable or not
claims.historical_only_meaning: The numbered chapter on whether alleged illness is curable begins below the divider on original PDF619 and continues PDF620

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: benevolent Planets aspect places of Significators
claims.historical_only_meaning: The author requires beneficial planets to aspect the illness-significator positions rather than any unrelated favorable placement

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: with Sextile
claims.historical_only_meaning: A sextile is explicitly named as one eligible favorable aspect

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: or Trine
claims.historical_only_meaning: A trine is separately named as a favorable aspect alternative to sextile

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Significators themselves in moveable Signes
claims.historical_only_meaning: Movable zodiac signs occupied by illness significators are an additional prerequisite to easy-curability claim

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Infirmities will be easily cured
claims.historical_only_meaning: Lilly claims recovery under the conjunction of favorable aspects and movable signs; there are no patients or trial records

groups.source_group: Fixed-sign and lack of benefic condition with poor prognosis

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Significators be in fixed Signes
claims.historical_only_meaning: The source introduces fixed signs as a contrary condition to movable signs for alleged recovery prognosis

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Fortunes lend no aspect to zodiac places
claims.historical_only_meaning: Absence of a helpful benefic aspect qualifies the adverse fixed-sign case

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Diseases of long continuance
claims.historical_only_meaning: The author asserts chronic illness under that compound condition, with no actual patient follow-up

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: hardly ever curable
claims.historical_only_meaning: A separate stronger version suggests incurability, not evidence that any real disease cannot be cured

groups.source_group: Exact versus remote aspect changes alleged curability time

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: more neer good aspect comes to Significators
claims.historical_only_meaning: The author claims closer beneficial contacts imply better prognosis rather than a binary indicator

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: or more partill it is
claims.historical_only_meaning: A partile/exact benefic contact is another qualifier in the graded cure-time rule

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: more ease is cure foreseen
claims.historical_only_meaning: Lilly alleges easier recovery from close/exact contacts, but supplies no chart-time mapping or clinical denominator

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: the more remote
claims.historical_only_meaning: A more distant beneficial aspect is described as an adverse alternative to exactness

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: worse and longer time required for cure
claims.historical_only_meaning: The author alleges longer or more difficult recovery when contact is remote, without any observed timelines

groups.source_group: Three purported planetary aid modes: money advice, medicine, magic

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Three Planets signifie cures of Diseases
claims.historical_only_meaning: Lilly lists three planet-associated recovery channels; this is a 1647 medical/magical taxonomy only

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Jupiter by Money and good Counsell
claims.historical_only_meaning: Jupiter is linked to funds and counsel in the source's cure taxonomy, not evidence that planets influence access to care

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Mercury by Medicine
claims.historical_only_meaning: Mercury is associated with medicine, but no medication, treatment or effectiveness is scientifically demonstrated

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Venus by Magick naturall Divine assistance by chance
claims.historical_only_meaning: Venus is associated with supposed magical/natural/divine/chance help; none is a treatment recommendation or verified recovery mechanism

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Jupiter Venus or Mercury well fortified
claims.historical_only_meaning: The source requires one of those three 'cure' signifier planets in a favorable state for another claimed positive branch

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: either Sextile or Trine to Significators diseases
claims.historical_only_meaning: That well-fortified helper also needs a favorable aspect to the disease-significator positions

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: they promise cure
claims.historical_only_meaning: The author alleges recoverability with both prerequisites; no clinical outcome has been verified

groups.source_group: Source exception claiming incurability even with prior cure promises

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Significators of infirmities in own houses
claims.historical_only_meaning: Illness signifier in its own domicile is named as one claimed adverse and seemingly paradoxical exception

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: or exaltations
claims.historical_only_meaning: Essential dignity by exaltation is a second alternative to house rulership in the source's contrary claim

claims.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: there remains little hope of remedy
claims.historical_only_meaning: The author asserts poor prognosis even when other rules might favor recovery; no tested precedence or medical justification
